characters.name: The Deaf Man
characters.prompt: An older Norwegian farmer from the 1400-1850 era, wearing simple woolen clothing, slightly hunched posture, a kind yet clueless expression due to his hearing impairment, often seen with farm tools.

characters.name: The Wife
characters.prompt: A middle-aged Norwegian woman in a traditional apron and headscarf from the 1400-1850 era, appearing both anxious and cunning, determined to hide her secrets.

characters.name: Tjenestegutten (the servant boy)
characters.prompt: A clever and mischievous young farmhand wearing coarse linen trousers and a simple shirt, with a playful grin that suggests he is up to something.

characters.name: Paal Andrestuen
characters.prompt: A neighbor man in modest Norwegian clothing of the 1400-1850 period, glancing around nervously, trying to remain unnoticed.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a rustic Norwegian farmstead from the 1400-1850 era with a wooden barn and a cozy farmhouse. Show the Deaf Man working with a flail or pitchfork in the barn, wearing old woolen attire. The sly Tjenestegut stands nearby, glancing at the farmhouse door. The Wife appears, carrying a wooden bowl of rømmegrøt, looking tense. Paal Andrestuen hides just out of sight behind a doorway or around a corner. Capture the comedic tension and secrecy in warm, earth-toned colors, emphasizing the old Norwegian setting and clothing.
modernMainImagePrompt: Picture a present-day Norwegian countryside setting with a modern-style farmhouse. The Deaf Man wears casual clothes and a modern hearing aid while raking leaves outside. The servant boy is now a slick teenager in a hoodie, texting on his phone yet slyly watching. The Wife appears in contemporary attire, holding a pot of freshly made porridge in a bright, modern kitchen. Paal Andrestuen peeks around a doorframe, wearing everyday clothes, looking guilty. Show the humor of the scene as everyone juggles secrets in a modern context.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a friendly, colorful cartoon-like scene set in old-time Norway. The Deaf Man has a gentle smile, wearing a cozy traditional outfit. The cheerful Tjenestegut happily stands by, perhaps holding a small wooden bucket. The Wife looks kind and motherly, offering a warm bowl of rømmegrøt. Paal Andrestuen peeks into the scene with a curious expression, but nothing scary or upsetting. Keep the shapes simple, the colors bright, and the atmosphere welcoming for young children.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Tegn en enkel scene i et gammelt norsk gårdstun fra 1400-1850. Den døve mannen jobber i låven, iført tykke ullklær. Tjenestegutten smiler lurt ved siden av, mens kona kommer med en skål rømmegrøt. Paal Andrestuen står i bakgrunnen og forsøker å ikke bli sett. Bruk et vennlig uttrykk og et historisk, men lettfattelig preg.
englishMainImagePrompt: Depict an old Norwegian farm from the 1400-1850 period. The Deaf Man stands in rustic woolen clothes, tending to farm chores. The mischievous servant boy looks on with a knowing grin. The Wife steps forward holding a steaming bowl of rømmegrøt. Nearby, Paal Andrestuen hovers at the edge of the scene, trying not to be noticed. Emphasize the historic look and comedic mood, highlighting the interplay of characters in a quaint, pastoral setting.
